description: Font converter: TTF/OTF, WOFF and WOFF2 containers, with the font's own embedding permission checked — Repackages a font you supply as base64 (up to 2 MB) between the sfnt (.ttf/.otf), WOFF and WOFF2 containers, for an agent or build step that needs a web font in a particular format: every table is carried over unchanged, the result is read back and its table digest compared with the source, and the font's own OS/2 embedding bits are checked first (a restricted font fails and nothing is returned).

fontBase64.description: Base64 of a .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2 file (not a .ttc collection), up to 2 MB.

to.description: Target container. sfnt is the plain .ttf/.otf file.

name: font-convert
